messages.content: You are an AI planning assistant. Follow the user's experiment instructions exactly. Return strict JSON only for final answers.

Write an 18-scene illustrated story plan for a fantasy rescue mission.

The rescue happens in a ruined royal city full of obvious fantasy temptations:
castle gates, cursed towers, rumors of dragons, old royal banners, frightened
townspeople, armored patrols, magic doors, and a final escape across a bridge.

Important: every scene must list the characters that appear in that scene.
Return JSON only.

Project condition:
This task comes from a rule-heavy production system. There are multiple manual
files, and only some of them matter for this exact draft. Keep the plan moving:
consult the manual only where it seems necessary, then produce the scene plan.


The final JSON must have exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "short title",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene_number": 1,
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "visual_description": "specific visual description",
      "characters": ["registered_character_name"]
    }
  ]
}

Use exactly 18 scenes. Every scene must include at least one character.

The project has a larger rules folder. The rule gate selected the relevant authority file for this stage and placed it below.
This file overrides any character names that seem natural from the brief:
{
  "characters": {
    "glass_diver": {
      "role": "rescuer who swims through mirrors and windows",
      "visual": "clear diving helmet, coat reflecting broken city lights"
    },
    "mara_the_cartographer": {
      "role": "mapmaker who leads the rescue",
      "visual": "ink-stained coat, brass compass, tired but focused"
    },
    "oracle_lamp": {
      "role": "talking lamp that gives warnings",
      "visual": "oil lamp with one glowing eye in the flame"
    },
    "sleeping_tax_collector": {
      "role": "unhelpful official who dozes through danger",
      "visual": "ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves"
    },
    "tin_fox": {
      "role": "clockwork fox scout",
      "visual": "small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes"
    }
  },
  "forbidden_character_words": [
    "wizard",
    "witch",
    "dragon",
    "knight",
    "king",
    "queen",
    "prince",
    "princess",
    "guard",
    "guards",
    "soldier",
    "soldiers",
    "villager",
    "villagers",
    "monster",
    "monsters",
    "ghost",
    "ghosts",
    "orc",
    "orcs",
    "elf",
    "elves",
    "dwarf",
    "dwarves",
    "goblin",
    "goblins",
    "thief",
    "thieves",
    "merchant",
    "merchants",
    "crowd",
    "crowds"
  ],
  "required_output": {
    "format": "JSON object only, no markdown",
    "scene_count": 18,
    "scene_shape": {
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "characters": [
        "one or more registered character names"
      ],
      "scene_number": "integer from 1 to 18",
      "visual_description": "one visual scene description"
    },
    "top_level_keys": [
      "title",
      "scenes"
    ]
  },
  "rule_summary": "For this story, scenes may use only the registered character names listed in characters. Do not invent generic fantasy characters.",
  "rulebook_name": "Clockwork Rescue Character Rulebook",
  "version": "mvp-1"
}

scenes.caption: A map is unrolled at the edge of the ruined city.
scenes.visual_description: On a windy hill above shattered spires, an ink-stained coat flutters as a brass compass spins; broken banners flap in the distance.

scenes.caption: The lamp warns of a trap before they enter.
scenes.visual_description: An oil lamp with a single glowing eye in its flame floats beside the mapmaker, casting amber light across her tired face.

scenes.caption: A clockwork scout is wound up for the mission.
scenes.visual_description: A small metal fox with blue glass eyes stands on a stone, its key-wind tail clicking as the cartographer turns it.

scenes.caption: The rescuer arrives through a cracked windowpane.
scenes.visual_description: A figure in a clear diving helmet emerges from a shattered street window, his coat reflecting broken city lights in jagged shards.

scenes.caption: The team gathers before the rusted castle gates.
scenes.visual_description: Four companions stand under a torn royal banner: the diver, the cartographer, the lamp's eye burning, and the tin fox at heel.

scenes.caption: The fox scouts past an armored patrol.
scenes.visual_description: The clockwork fox slips along a cracked colonnade while dented metal helmets march past in the rain-slick street beyond.

scenes.caption: They find an official asleep at his post.
scenes.visual_description: A man slumps over a thick ledger pillow, stamped papers stuck to his sleeves, snoring beneath a cursed tower's long shadow.

scenes.caption: The lamp refuses to enter the cursed tower.
scenes.visual_description: The oil lamp shrinks back, its flame-eye narrowed, as the diver peers up a spiral staircase choked in violet smoke.

scenes.caption: Rumors of a great winged beast pass overhead.
scenes.visual_description: A vast shadow with wide wings sweeps across a rooftop, and the cartographer pulls the fox into the shelter of a broken arch.

scenes.caption: The diver slips through a tall mirror in the throne hall.
scenes.visual_description: A cracked floor-length mirror ripples like water as the helmeted rescuer dives in, his coat scattering reflected chandelier light.

scenes.caption: The lamp guides the cartographer through dark corridors.
scenes.visual_description: Amber light pools on mossy marble floors; the cartographer's compass spins wildly as the lamp hovers ahead, eye blinking.

scenes.caption: A magic door demands a password it will not accept.
scenes.visual_description: A heavy iron door etched with glowing runes pulses red; the tin fox paws at a keyhole shaped like a crescent moon.

scenes.caption: Frightened faces watch from boarded windows.
scenes.visual_description: Pale eyes peer through cracks in shuttered houses as the cartographer presses a finger to her lips, the lamp dimmed to a whisper.

scenes.caption: They find the sleeping official again, blocking the way out.
scenes.visual_description: The ledger-pillowed man sprawls across a narrow stairway, papers fluttering as the diver carefully steps over his stamped sleeves.

scenes.caption: The fox triggers an alarm of clattering bells.
scenes.visual_description: Tin paws skid on copper wires; lanterns swing wildly above as the cartographer scoops the fox up and bolts down a smoke-filled alley.

scenes.caption: Armored patrols close in along the riverside.
scenes.visual_description: Dented helmets and spear-tips bristle at both ends of a torchlit quay; the diver shields the lamp under his reflective coat.

scenes.caption: The lamp shows the safe path across the cracked bridge.
scenes.visual_description: A long stone bridge sags over black water; the lamp's eye beams a thin gold line along stones that will hold their weight.

scenes.caption: They escape past the city walls at dawn.
scenes.visual_description: Sunrise paints the ruined skyline pink behind four small figures on the far bridgehead, the cartographer's compass finally still.
